premises.text: More cattle weight means more money, so frequent weight monitoring is critical yet rarely obtained today
premises.evidence_span: To summarize it, more weight, more money

premises.text: Portable 3D camera software monitors weight variation frequently, stress-free, and ten times faster
premises.evidence_span: monitor weight variation frequently at a stress-free manner for the cow, at a rate that is 10 times faster than the traditional process

premises.text: With the data, farmers know when to sell, change feed, treat sick cows, dose medicine, and pick genetics
premises.evidence_span: farmers know when to sell, change feed and supplement, treat sick cows, prescribe the right amount of medicine, identify the best genetics for the next purchase

premises.text: Automatic pass-through design serves all farm sizes versus still-photo tools for small farms only
premises.evidence_span: they are only suitable for small farms. Olho do Dono works automatically as the cow passes in front of it

premises.text: Portable hardware and R$1 per animal-month pricing plus product-commission recommendations beat expensive installed scales
premises.evidence_span: Passage scale competitors are expensive to install, and one scale must be installed in every place that the cattle stays

value.text: Increase beef cattle productivity and profitability with continuous weight insight
value.evidence_span: Let's increase the beef cattle productivity and profitability while maintaining the well-being of the cow
